title: Basic opens D(r) of Proj: basis, products, homogeneous components
statement: Let $S=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}S_n$ be an $\mathbf N$-graded commutative ring and $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj], the set of homogeneous prime ideals $\mathfrak p\subseteq S$ with $S_+=\bigoplus_{n\ge1}S_n\not\subseteq\mathfrak p$, with the topology induced from $\operatorname{Spec}S$ (closed sets: the sets of such $\mathfrak p$ containing a given subset of $S$). For an arbitrary $r\in S$ let $D(r)=\{\mathfrak p\in X: r\notin\mathfrak p\}$. Then: (i) every $D(r)$ is open and the sets $D(r)$, $r\in S$, form a basis of the topology of $X$; (ii) $D(rr')=D(r)\cap D(r')$ for $r,r'\in S$; (iii) if $r=\sum_{i\ge0}r_i$ with $r_i\in S_i$, then $D(r)=\bigcup_{i\ge0}D(r_i)$.
